title: Bigfoot
summary: Bigfoot is a mysterious wild Titan that resides in a snowy mountain range. Its appearance is that of a large muscular ape-like creature covered in white fur with large hands and feet while its face is decorated with Meso-American tribal markings.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Bigfoot roams the snowy mountains, and inspired the myths of the Yeti and the abominable snowman in Asian mythology. [TCG:SAS-168]

The Huntik team were given a difficult mission to track down the Bigfoot and capture it. 
[TCG:SAS-156]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: With its large hands and feet, Bigfoot can move across the icy terrain at incredible speeds. Its special ability allows it to avoid defeat in combat by escaping from the scene. It also possesses sharp teeth and claws. {{Source|TCG:SAS-168|SAS-168}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Bigfoot shares its name with the [[:wikipedia:Bigfoot|Bigfoot]], a forest dwelling creature from North American folklore. Its appearance is based off the [[:wikipedia:Yeti|Yeti]] from Asian mythology, a white furred creature associated with snowy, mountainous regions.

'''Bigfoot''' is a mysterious wild [[Titan]] that resides in a snowy mountain range. Its appearance is that of a large muscular ape-like creature covered in white fur with large hands and feet while its face is decorated with Meso-American tribal markings. 

== History ==
Bigfoot roams the snowy mountains, and inspired the myths of the Yeti and the abominable snowman in Asian mythology. {{Source|TCG:SAS-168|SAS-168}}

The Huntik team were given a difficult mission to track down the Bigfoot and capture it. 
{{Source|TCG:SAS-156|SAS-156}}

== Abilities ==
With its large hands and feet, Bigfoot can move across the icy terrain at incredible speeds. Its special ability allows it to avoid defeat in combat by escaping from the scene. It also possesses sharp teeth and claws. {{Source|TCG:SAS-168|SAS-168}}

== Trivia ==
*Bigfoot shares its name with the [[:wikipedia:Bigfoot|Bigfoot]], a forest dwelling creature from North American folklore. Its appearance is based off the [[:wikipedia:Yeti|Yeti]] from Asian mythology, a white furred creature associated with snowy, mountainous regions.
